item.title: By: DougC
item.dc:creator: DougC
item.description: According to FBI statistics, the homicide rate in 1915 was approx. 1.2 per 100,000 people. With the estimated 1915 U.S population of 100.5 million, the actual homicide rate was far more than 230.

item.title: By: David Freedman
item.dc:creator: David Freedman
item.description:
If the dates for states # 46, 47, and 48 were --
46: Oklahoma November 16, 1907 47: New Mexico January 6, 1912 48: Arizona February 14, 1912
Why were there only 45 stars in 1915?

48: Arizona February 14, 1912

item.title: By: Michael A. Lewis
item.dc:creator: Michael A. Lewis
item.description:
A century is a pretty long time in terms of human perception. There are not many people alive today who remember 1915.
A century is a short time geologically, merely an eye blink, even shorter cosmically.
And yet we're still people, with the same love, fear, attachments, imagination and dreams. A century in the human mind is no time at all.
item.content:encoded:
A century is a pretty long time in terms of human perception. There are not many people alive today who remember 1915.

A century is a short time geologically, merely an eye blink, even shorter cosmically.

And yet we’re still people, with the same love, fear, attachments, imagination and dreams. A century in the human mind is no time at all.
